patch_list: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, including advertising-ID and app-set-ID collection. The Devolutions product telemetry is sent by the .NET code inside the AOT assemblies, use the app's "Disable sending analytics" o…

Bypasses the certificate validation of the .NET/Mono TLS stack so a debugging proxy can read the app's HTTPS traffic. Certificate pinning implemented in managed code lives in the ahead-of-time compiled .NET assemblies and is not affected.…
